name: Fetch Rayvn files
info:
Fetches all transferable files for a single Rayvn entry.
Mirrors Fetch Wasos files — same contract, same structure.

### Input
- msg.payload — entry object (raw Rayvn entry after Classify files)
- msg.metadata — standard metadata with .files.items containing synthetic file objects with .url

### Logic
1. Prepare download list — backs up entry, sends one message per file with join parts
2. Get Rayvn file (per file) — builds plain HTTP GET to signed URL, downloads buffer
3. Compress? — routes oversized files to Compress Files (passes through for WaSOS, max_upload_bytes is null)
4. Store file via global context — stores buffer in global context, builds context_key
5. Join — reassembles file results into array
6. Merge files and rebuild entry — separates successes from failures, rebuilds entry

### Output
- msg.payload — rebuilt entry
- msg.metadata — updated .files.items (stored) and .files.failed
